name: Saint Ambrose
history: A Roman governor acclaimed bishop of Milan by the people while still unbaptised. He wrote hymns still sung in the Divine Office, defended the Church against emperors, and his preaching helped bring Saint Augustine to faith.
meditation: Ambrose made an emperor do public penance. Where do you need to repent publicly, even in a small way?
prayer: O God, who didst give blessed Ambrósii to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
